title: Dynamics 365 finance and operations: migrate environments from Lifecycle Services to Power Platform admin center
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly says finance and operations storage capacity has no documented API. The Power Platform API exposes tenant capacity, consumption and availability for finance and operations; the migration paths, preview restrictions and last-sandbox warning are supported.

claims.claim: Self-service migration moves management of an existing finance and operations environment from Lifecycle Services to Power Platform admin center.
claims.quote: The self-service environment migration feature moves management of an existing finance and operations apps environment from Microsoft Dynamics Lifecycle Services to the Microsoft Power Platform admin center.

claims.quote: Ensure that the person who starts the migration is an administrator of the linked Power Platform environment. ... Enter the environment name exactly as shown, and then select Start migration.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Migrating the last sandbox while production stays in Lifecycle Services prevents promoting updates, including custom code changes, to production until production is migrated.
claims.quote: If production is still managed in Lifecycle Services, you can't promote updates, including custom code changes, to production until you migrate production to the Power Platform admin center.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Keeping at least one sandbox in Lifecycle Services until production migration is ready follows Microsoft's warning.
claims.quote: To avoid an unplanned code freeze, keep at least one sandbox in Lifecycle Services until you're ready to migrate production.

claims.claim: No API for starting this Lifecycle Services to Power Platform admin center migration is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: finance operations Lifecycle Services migrate Power Platform admin center migration API Power Platform API pac admin PowerShell; Lifecycle Services migration API admin center self-service. Opened migration article and pac admin reference; no migration-start operation found.

claims.claim: The finance and operations capacity report is at Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Capacity add-ons > Finance and Operations.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Power Platform admin center. ... select Licensing. ... select Capacity add-ons. ... Select Finance and Operations.

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls table; Governance controls
claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no API for reporting finance and operations storage capacity.
claims.quote: GET https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/tenantCapacity?api-version=2024-10-01; CapacityType: FinOpsDatabase, FinOpsFile; TenantCapacityAndConsumptionModel: consumption, totalCapacity, status; CapacitySummary: finOpsStatus, finOpsStatusMessage.
claims.fix: Set controls[1].api to kind 'power-platform-api', call 'GET https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/tenantCapacity?api-version=2024-10-01', docs 'https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/power-platform/licensing/tenant-capacity-details/get-tenant-capacity-details'. Append to its note: 'The API reports tenant capacity and consumption for FinOpsDatabase and FinOpsFile and finance and operations availability through capacitySummary.finOpsStatus; it is not a migration control.' Mirror that API in the rendered row, add its reference to sources, and replace the prose absence with: 'Microsoft Learn documents no API for starting the migration at the time of writing (November 2026). The Power Platform API reports tenant finance and operations capacity, consumption and availability.'

claims.claim: The integration prerequisite check is visible at Lifecycle Services > project > Environments > environment > Full details > Power Platform migration (Preview) > Power Platform environment is linked.
claims.quote: open the project that contains the environment. ... In the Environments section ... select Full details. ... expand Power Platform migration (Preview). ... Power Platform environment is linked.

claims.claim: GET [Organization URI]/api/data/v9.1/RetrieveFinanceAndOperationsIntegrationDetails is the documented Dataverse integration-status call.
claims.quote: GET [Organization URI]/api/data/v9.1/RetrieveFinanceAndOperationsIntegrationDetails

claims.claim: The Dataverse call validates whether integration exists and returns the linked finance and operations tenant and environment details.
claims.quote: If the Power Platform environment is linked to a finance and operations apps environment through the Power Platform integration, the API returns the Microsoft Entra tenant and environment details of the finance and operations apps environment.

claims.claim: The integration article does not state which role may call RetrieveFinanceAndOperationsIntegrationDetails.
claims.quote: Searched: RetrieveFinanceAndOperationsIntegrationDetails role permissions. Opened Enable Power Platform integration and read Verify Power Platform integration status at runtime, request, response and properties; no caller role is stated there.

claims.claim: No new data location is documented for this control-plane migration.
claims.quote: Searched: Lifecycle Services migration data location. Opened migration article and unified admin overview; migration states that the database is not moved and infrastructure is not materially changed. No new migration data location found.

claims.claim: The existing finance and operations storage report compares usage with licence entitlement.
claims.quote: The finance and operations storage capacity report shows how much finance and operations storage your organization is using compared with how much its license entitles it to.

claims.claim: Finance and operations capacity reporting covers the tenant and its environments.
claims.quote: Storage reporting covers usage at the tenant and environment level. All environments in all Lifecycle Services projects on the tenant are included in storage reporting.

claims.claim: RetrieveFinanceAndOperationsIntegrationDetails is a read-only integration check, not an operation that starts migration or changes integration.
claims.quote: The RetrieveFinanceAndOperationsIntegrationDetails API is available in Dataverse to validate the status of the Power Platform integration for the Power Platform environment. ... Read-only

claims.claim: The migration article links the finance and operations storage capacity report for resolving the database capacity prerequisite failure.
claims.quote: Database storage capacity is available | Review finance and operations storage capacity, and free or purchase enough capacity to clear the deficit.

claims.claim: The migration section has four green prerequisite checks: Deployed status, linked Power Platform environment, available database storage capacity and administrator of the linked environment.
claims.quote: Verify that all the following prerequisite checks have a green check mark: Environment is in Deployed status. Power Platform environment is linked. Database storage capacity is available. You are an administrator of the linked Power Platform environment.
